_comment: Edge smoothness floor, measured from the shipped weight maps. edgeRough is the staircase (higher is worse); edgeWidth is the transition in pixels. A build may not ship an edge rougher than these; width is held to an absolute 2.4 px rather than to the previous build, since a properly resolved boundary is both narrower and smoother. Set after the border band was given its inward half - a photographed edge ramps through the boundary, and the inner side was clamped to a hard 1 - taking the mean from 87.4 to 79.9. Edited deliberately, with crops compared, never to make a red build green.
